author: kycrafft
body:
Well 13 kits spread out across 50 levels....nope. 

Kits:

Soldier: full leather except for chain helmet with projectile prot 2, stone sword
Abilities: slowness 1
Level: 3

Alchemist: gold chestplate, leather boots and pants wood sword, 2 instant damage 1 potions, 1 slowness potion
Abilities: none
Level: 10

Thermo: gold helmet and boots, leather chestplate, wood axe with sharp 2
Abilities: cannot be set on fire by pyros, cannot be affected by negative potions effects 
Level: 18

Titan: stone axe, leather helmet, iron boots, and chain leggings
Abilities: right-click with the stone axe to deal 4 hearts of damage to anyone within a 4 block radius (took breaking noise) This has a cool down of 10 seconds and gives you slowness 2 for 3 seconds. 
Level: 26
